+import os
+from typing import List, Sequence
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+

+OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", "text-embedding-3-small")
+
+
+def embed_script(script: str) -> List[float]:
